player_prompt.intro: A na-anọchite anya gị site na 'P' na grid. Ihe akara grid: ' ' = Igwe oyi (dị mma ịga ije) 'H' = Oghere (daa ma tufuo!) 'G' = Ihe mgbaru ọsọ (ruo nke a iji merie!) 'P' = Ọnọdụ gị ugbu a Ihe omume dịnụ: elu, ala, aka ekpe, aka nri (ma ọ bụ w, a, s, d) Pịnye ihe omume gị dị ka: [up], [down], [left], [right] ma ọ bụ [w], [a], [s], [d] Ebumnuche: Gaa site na mmalite (elu aka ekpe) gaa na ihe mgbaru ọsọ (ala aka nri) n'enweghị ịdaba n'ime oghere ọ bụla !

board.current_board: Board ugbu a: {board} Ihe ndị dịnụ: {actions}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ọkpụkpọ ihe na-abaghị uru. Jiri [up], [down], [left], [right] ma ọ bụ [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Ihe a na-amaghị ama '{action}'. Jiri elu, ala, aka ekpe, aka nri, ma ọ bụ w, a, s, d.
invalid_move.hit_wall: Ị gbalịrị ịkwaga {action} ma kụọ mgbidi!

outcome.win: Ekele, ị ruru ihe mgbaru ọsọ gị!
outcome.fell_in_hole: Ị dabara n'olulu! Egwuregwu agwụla. I mezue {pct}% nke njem ahụ ruo n'ihe mgbaru ọsọ.
outcome.turn_limit: Ị ruru oke ntụgharị! Egwuregwu agwụla. I mezue {pct}% nke njem ahụ ruo n'ihe mgbaru ọsọ.
